extracted.intended_audience: applicants and practitioners filing U.S. utility or plant patent applications or RCEs who seek Prioritized Examination (Track One)
extracted.subtask_description: Filing a Certification and Request for Prioritized Examination (Track One) under 37 CFR 1.102(e), including required form, fees, electronic filing, and timing rules for original utility/plant applications and RCEs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governing authority for Track One requests
rubrics_metrics.description: The criteria for filing a request for Prioritized Examination, Track One, is set forth in 37 CFR 1.102(e) and MPEP § 708.02(b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For the relevant patent laws and rules applicable to certification and request for Prioritized Examination, Track One, see 37 CFR 1.16, 1.17, 1.18, 1.102(e), 1.114, and MPEP § 708.02(b). The Federal Register is the authoritative source and should be consulted to verify authenticity of CFR language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use required form PTO/AIA/424
rubrics_metrics.description: A specific form is available: Certification and Request for Prioritized Examination under 37 CFR 1.102(e) (PTO/AIA/424).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the PTO/AIA/424 form when submitting the certification and request. For further assistance, contact the Petitions Help Desk (8:30 AM - 5 PM EDT).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pay Track One-specific fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Payment of the Prioritized Examination, Track One related fees is required: (i) Track One Prioritized Examination Fee, 1817/2817/3817 (Large Entity/Small Entity/Micro Entity); (ii) Processing Fee, 1830/2830/3830 (Large Entity/Small Entity/Micro Entity); and (iii) Publication Fee, 1504.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the current USPTO Fee Schedule for the applicable Track One-specific fee amounts by entity size. Fee-schedule changes may not be reflected in the MPEP; always verify current amounts via the USPTO Fee Schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pay additional filing fees on original application filing date
rubrics_metrics.description: For the filing of an original utility or plant application, the Track One fees (i)-(iii) plus the Basic Fee, Search Fee, Examination Fee, and Application Size Fee must be paid on the filing date of the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All listed fees (Track One fees and standard filing/search/exam/size fees) must be submitted on the application filing date to secure Track One treatment for an original filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing of payment when filing an RCE
rubrics_metrics.description: For the filing of a Request for Continued Examination (RCE), the Track One fees (i)-(iii) must be paid at the time the certification and request for prioritized examination under 37 CFR 1.102(e) is filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlike an original filing (where additional standard fees are paid on the filing date), for an RCE the Track One fees are due when the certification and request are submitted with the RCE.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic filing requirement via Patent Electronic System
rubrics_metrics.description: With the filing of an original utility application, all components for the original utility application and accompanied required items for Prioritized Examination, Track One, must be filed electronically via the Patent Electronic System.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For filings with or after an RCE, all of the components/required items for Prioritized Examination, Track One must also be filed electronically via the Patent Electronic System. Ensure use of the Patent Electronic System for both original and RCE Track One submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete components and required items at time of filing
rubrics_metrics.description: All of the components for the original utility application and accompanied required items for Prioritized Examination, Track One, must be filed (i.e., be present) as part of the electronic submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track One certification and request depend on submission of the complete set of required application components/items; consult the Track One program page for information surrounding required elements and avoid incomplete submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult program page and USPTO Fee Schedule for details
rubrics_metrics.description: Information surrounding the filing of a certification and request for Prioritized Examination, Track One, is available on the Track One program page and current USPTO Fee Schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Track One program page for procedural details and the USPTO Fee Schedule for current fee codes and amounts. The Federal Register should be consulted for authoritative CFR language if verification is needed.
